title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta24

## Freeze mixed History fallback between lifecycle checkpoints

Beta23 field diagnostics confirmed that vendor-owned per-zone SVG checkpoints and
the static prepared-map model no longer rebuild continuously. The remaining hot
path was visible on i108: one map zone still used the History fallback, so every
live History/MQTT trail revision invalidated the legacy combined current-cycle
render even while the active mower was working in a vendor-owned zone.

Beta24 removes that dependency.

- Raw `history.trail_revision` no longer participates in the MapArtifactManager
  hot-path cache key merely because one map zone is not vendor-owned.
- Mixed vendor + History rendering now uses a coordinator-owned
  `fallback_checkpoint_revision`.
- The current History fallback is frozen between lifecycle checkpoints while the
  live prepared/MQTT layer continues to update independently.
- Direct current-cycle consumers, including the backend map snapshot, share the
  same checkpoint token and therefore cannot bypass the frozen fallback cache.
- A fallback checkpoint is advanced on active physical-zone exit and when the
  mower settles into docked / idle / charging / error.
- Vendor ownership changes, confirmed cycle/reset identity, map revision and
  mowing-width changes remain independent invalidation reasons.

This keeps the beta23 rule intact: expensive base geometry is event-driven;
live movement belongs to the live layer.

## Diagnostics

`map_artifacts` now also exposes:

- `fallback_checkpoint_revision`;
- `fallback_checkpoint_count`;
- `last_fallback_checkpoint_reason`;
- `last_fallback_checkpoint_history_revision`;
- `current_history_revision`;
- `fallback_zone_count`.

These counters make the intended behavior directly testable: while an unowned
fallback zone exists, `current_history_revision` may advance rapidly during
mowing without increasing the fallback checkpoint revision or expensive base
build count.

## Regression coverage

New beta24 tests reproduce the mixed i108-style state:

- one vendor-owned zone plus one active History fallback zone;
- 50 consecutive live History point/revision updates do not rebuild the base;
- direct `current_cycle_render_manager` reads also keep the frozen fallback;
- a zone-exit checkpoint publishes the accumulated fallback exactly once;
- a mowing-to-docked transition coalesces zone-exit + settled into one fallback
  checkpoint.

ZoneLedger, coverage/progress, vendor trail cycle ownership, Schedule semantics
and the rule for scheduled-but-not-entered zones are unchanged.
